out_of_scope_policy: Atlas tracks SIGNIFICANT crisis/risk narratives only. Reject (OUT_OF_SCOPE) any signal that is not substantively about an acute or developing crisis/risk with potential for significant harm, disruption, or instability. Reject even when a crisis WORD appears if the signal is really about something else. Explicit rejects: routine business/markets, sport, culture/entertainment, book/film reviews, shopping/product/lifestyle, local human-interest or memorials, celebrity, ordinary weather forecasts, procedural/legal items that are not themselves a crisis, and satire. A category is assigned ONLY if the signal clears this bar AND matches that category's `includes` without hitting its `excludes`.

categories.label: Agriculture and Crop Risk
categories.definition: Crop failures, pest outbreaks, fertilizer shortages, or harvest shocks threatening food production.
categories.includes: Drought/flood impact on crops, locust plagues, fertilizer price spikes, harvest losses, farm bankruptcy waves.
categories.excludes: Food price stress (see food-price-stress), routine agricultural market reports.

categories.label: Armed Conflict Escalation
categories.definition: Escalation of armed violence between organized groups or states.
categories.includes: Battlefield engagements, airstrikes, artillery exchanges, territorial gains/losses, ceasefire violations, attacks on military targets.
categories.excludes: Urban gang violence (see gang-control-urban-security), terrorism without state/group context, crime not linked to conflict.

categories.label: Constitutional or Institutional Crisis
categories.definition: Constitutional conflicts, court-government confrontations, or institutional breakdowns.
categories.includes: Impeachment proceedings, constitutional court clashes, government shutdowns, coup d'état, martial law.
categories.excludes: Routine political disagreements, election disputes (see election-legitimacy-dispute).

categories.label: Corruption Investigation
categories.definition: Major corruption probes, bribery scandals, or anti-corruption crackdowns.
categories.includes: High-level bribery cases, embezzlement revelations, asset seizures, whistleblower cases, anti-corruption protests.
categories.excludes: Routine audits, minor misconduct, corporate fraud without political angle.

categories.label: Currency and Debt Stress
categories.definition: Currency collapse, sovereign debt crisis, or IMF negotiations.
categories.includes: Currency devaluation, hyperinflation, debt default, bond yield spikes, IMF bailout talks, reserve depletion.
categories.excludes: Routine market fluctuations, stock market corrections, corporate debt.

categories.label: Cyberattack on Infrastructure
categories.definition: Cyberattacks targeting critical infrastructure such as government, finance, utilities, or telecoms.
categories.includes: Ransomware on hospitals, DDoS on banks, state-sponsored hacks on power grids, data breaches of government systems.
categories.excludes: Routine cybercrime, phishing scams, individual account hacks.

categories.label: Disease Outbreak
categories.definition: Emerging or re-emerging infectious disease outbreaks, epidemics, or pandemics.
categories.includes: Novel virus outbreaks, vaccine campaigns during outbreaks, quarantine measures, hospital capacity strain, WHO emergency declarations.
categories.excludes: Chronic diseases, routine seasonal flu, heat-related illness (see heat-health-risk).

categories.label: Disinformation and Influence Operation
categories.definition: Coordinated disinformation campaigns or influence operations targeting public opinion or elections.
categories.includes: State-backed propaganda, fake news networks, bot farms, election interference, conspiracy theory amplification.
categories.excludes: Individual misinformation, satire, media bias without coordination.

categories.label: Election Legitimacy Dispute
categories.definition: Contested election results, fraud allegations, or institutional disputes over electoral processes.
categories.includes: Election fraud claims, court battles over results, delayed vote counts, foreign interference allegations, post-election violence.
categories.excludes: Routine election coverage, campaign strategy, policy debates.

categories.label: Energy Grid Instability
categories.definition: Power outages, grid failures, or energy rationing due to generation shortages or infrastructure damage.
categories.includes: Blackouts, load shedding, grid collapse, power plant failures, energy rationing, cyberattacks on grid.
categories.excludes: Routine maintenance, local outages, fuel supply issues (see oil-gas-supply-risk).

categories.label: Flood and Landslide Disaster
categories.definition: Flooding, landslides, or heavy rain events causing damage, evacuations, or humanitarian response.
categories.includes: River floods, flash floods, coastal storm surges, landslides, mudslides, evacuation orders, disaster relief operations.
categories.excludes: Drought (see water-stress-drought), heatwaves (see heat-health-risk), routine weather forecasts.

categories.label: Food Price Stress
categories.definition: Food inflation, shortages, or affordability crises leading to hunger or social unrest.
categories.includes: Spikes in staple food prices, bread riots, food rationing, hunger protests, supply chain disruptions causing shortages.
categories.excludes: Crop failures (see agriculture-crop-risk), general inflation, luxury food trends.

categories.label: Forced Displacement
categories.definition: Internal or cross-border displacement due to conflict, violence, or disasters.
categories.includes: Refugee flows, IDP camps, ethnic cleansing, disaster evacuations, expulsion orders.
categories.excludes: Voluntary migration, economic migration, routine border crossings.

categories.label: Fuel Subsidy Unrest
categories.definition: Protests or strikes triggered by fuel price hikes or subsidy removal.
categories.includes: Fuel price protests, transport strikes, subsidy reform backlash, blockades at fuel depots.
categories.excludes: General labor strikes (see labor-strike-disruption), routine fuel price changes.

categories.label: Gang Control and Urban Security
categories.definition: Criminal armed groups exerting control over urban areas, transport, or services.
categories.includes: Gang takeovers of neighborhoods, extortion of businesses, control of prisons, transport routes, or utilities; turf wars.
categories.excludes: State-on-state conflict, organized crime without territorial control, petty crime.

categories.label: Gender Violence and Rights
categories.definition: Gender-based violence, femicide, or reproductive rights crises sparking mobilization.
categories.includes: Femicide waves, sexual violence in conflict, abortion rights protests, #MeToo movements, anti-gender-violence marches.
categories.excludes: Routine gender equality policy, individual crimes without systemic context.

categories.label: Heat and Public Health Risk
categories.definition: Extreme heat events causing mortality, health warnings, or infrastructure strain.
categories.includes: Heatwaves, heat-related deaths, hospital admissions for heatstroke, cooling center openings, power grid stress from AC demand.
categories.excludes: General climate change, drought (see water-stress-drought), routine summer weather.

categories.label: Housing Cost Pressure
categories.definition: Housing affordability crises, rent spikes, evictions, or mortgage stress.
categories.includes: Rent surges, eviction waves, homelessness spikes, housing protests, mortgage default crises.
categories.excludes: Real estate market trends, construction industry news, luxury housing.

categories.label: Humanitarian Access Under Conflict
categories.definition: Constraints on aid delivery due to violence or bureaucratic obstruction.
categories.includes: Aid convoy attacks, blocked corridors, visa denials for aid workers, looting of supplies.
categories.excludes: General displacement (see forced-displacement), natural disasters without conflict.

categories.label: Labor Strike Disruption
categories.definition: Major labor strikes or union actions causing economic or service disruption.
categories.includes: General strikes, transport strikes, hospital strikes, factory walkouts, wage protests, collective bargaining breakdowns.
categories.excludes: Routine union meetings, individual labor disputes, student protests (see student-youth-protest).

categories.label: Migration and Border Pressure
categories.definition: Large-scale migration flows or border crises causing political or humanitarian strain.
categories.includes: Caravan migrations, border wall disputes, asylum seeker surges, pushbacks, detention center conditions.
categories.excludes: Routine immigration processes, non-crisis border activities.

categories.label: Mining and Resource Safety Crisis
categories.definition: Mine accidents, extraction-site safety failures, illegal mining, or resource-disaster events.
categories.includes: Mine collapses, toxic spills, illegal mining crackdowns, tailings dam failures, regulatory fallout.
categories.excludes: Routine mining operations, commodity price fluctuations.

categories.label: Oil and Gas Supply Risk
categories.definition: Disruption to oil, gas, or LNG supply due to conflict, accidents, or political decisions.
categories.includes: Pipeline sabotage, refinery shutdowns, OPEC production cuts, LNG terminal attacks, tanker seizures.
categories.excludes: Routine price changes, demand fluctuations, renewable energy news.

categories.label: Press Freedom Crackdown
categories.definition: Government or non-state attacks on journalists or media outlets.
categories.includes: Journalist arrests, media shutdowns, censorship orders, attacks on newsrooms, internet shutdowns targeting media.
categories.excludes: General internet shutdowns (see telecom-internet-shutdown), defamation lawsuits.

categories.label: Sanctions and Diplomatic Pressure
categories.definition: International sanctions, diplomatic expulsions, or treaty disputes causing geopolitical tension.
categories.includes: Economic sanctions, asset freezes, diplomatic expulsions, treaty withdrawals, nuclear negotiations, UN resolutions.
categories.excludes: Routine diplomacy, trade agreements without crisis, cultural exchanges.

categories.label: Student and Youth Protest
categories.definition: Student-led protests or youth movements demanding political or social change.
categories.includes: Campus protests, education funding marches, youth climate strikes, student union activism, school boycotts.
categories.excludes: General labor strikes, non-student protests, routine school events.

categories.label: Telecom or Internet Shutdown
categories.definition: Government-ordered or conflict-related internet/telecom outages disrupting connectivity.
categories.includes: Internet blackouts during protests, mobile network shutdowns, censorship of social media, fiber cuts.
categories.excludes: Routine network maintenance, local outages, cyberattacks (see cyberattack-infrastructure).

categories.label: Trade and Export Restriction
categories.definition: Export bans, tariffs, trade disputes, or shipping restrictions causing economic disruption.
categories.includes: Export bans on food/energy, tariff escalations, trade war announcements, port blockades, sanctions on trade.
categories.excludes: Routine trade negotiations, WTO disputes without crisis impact, company-level supply chain issues.

categories.label: Transport Corridor Disruption
categories.definition: Disruption to major transport corridors (ports, canals, railways, roads) due to accidents, weather, or conflict.
categories.includes: Port strikes, canal blockages, bridge collapses, railway sabotage, road blockades by protesters, chokepoint closures.
categories.excludes: Routine transport updates, non-crisis logistics news.

categories.label: Water Stress and Drought
categories.definition: Drought conditions, water scarcity, or conflict over water resources.
categories.includes: Prolonged dry spells, reservoir depletion, water rationing, irrigation restrictions, water disputes between regions/countries.
categories.excludes: Flood events, general climate change discussion without acute crisis.

categories.label: Earthquake or volcanic disaster
categories.definition: Seismic or volcanic events causing casualties, damage, or evacuation.
categories.includes: earthquakes, aftershocks, tsunamis, volcanic eruptions, ashfall evacuations
categories.excludes: routine seismology research; disaster anniversaries; flood/landslide (own category)

categories.label: Wildfire or severe-storm disaster
categories.definition: Wildfires, hurricanes/cyclones, tornadoes, or severe storms causing harm.
categories.includes: wildfires, hurricanes, typhoons, cyclones, tornadoes, blizzards causing damage
categories.excludes: ordinary weather forecasts; heat without fire/storm (heat-health category)
